pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal dark regions with relatively sharp edge gradients and variable spatial areas, transitioning from smaller, more rounded patches on the lower neck to larger, more angular shapes on the upper flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways with frequent tri-radiate and quadri-radiate junction nodes; pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the visible flank region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated profile of the mane along the dorsal neck, appearing as a dense series of vertical dark fibers against the background.
